{{Quote|Captain Archer's ARC squadron will take up the pursuit.|The assistant director|<ref name="MF" />}}
Serving as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] '''Archer''' led a [[Archer's squadron|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were charged by the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] with chasing a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']], that had been caught using a clearance code it was not authorized to know. Despite Archer's best efforts, the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170s]] and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing starfighters]] that later coordinated with two Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] were unable to capture the ''Envoy''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Disable or destroy?''"<br />"''Archer's call. Have a forensics team standing by to retrieve the bodies and pick through the wreckage if it comes to that.|The assistant director and Armand Isard|<ref name="MF" />}}
Archer was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] created to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. A [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he led his own [[Archer's squadron|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Soon after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Archer's [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was called upon by the [[Unidentified assistant director|assistant director]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] to pursue the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']] as it tried to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after being reported for using a security code its [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] should not have known.<ref name="MF" />

Archer and his men took up the chase in at least seven [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170s]] and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing starfighters]]. [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] gave Archer authorization to disable or destroy the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]; however, though Archer's squadron fired upon the vessel, the ''Stellar Envoy'' merged with a swarm of civilian craft trying to leave the planet in the battle's wake. Archer and his pilots were forced to hold their fire and follow the ''Envoy'' from a distance. When the ''Envoy'' reached the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], it was designated as a target by two [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle]] and [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Home]], which the ship flew into for cover from the squadron's resurgent fire. Shots from Archer's squadron struck the craft before the ''Envoy'' was caught by a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] from a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], the ''[[Integrity]]''. Nonetheless, the ''Stellar Envoy'' jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] before the squadron could disable it.<ref name="MF" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter Jango Fett, Archer was genetically identical to his template. Fett was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="DB" /> Archer was trained to fly starfighters and possessed the leadership skills needed to command his own squadron in battle.<ref name="MF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Archer appeared in the [[2008]] novel [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']] by [[James Luceno]]. Although it was not directly specified if Archer was a clone or non-cloned [[Officer/Legends|officer]], the novel stated flatly that the pilots chasing the ''Envoy'' were clones. Therefore, this article treats him as a clone.<ref name="MF" />
